educationalModelNote: All numerical models are simplified educational models, not specifications of a real robot.

missions.title: WORKSPACE & REACH
missions.concept: Reachability is defined by geometry, joint limits and collision constraints — not by visual proximity alone.
missions.scenario: A shelf target looks close, but the arm must reach it without leaving its joint envelope.
missions.goalText: Match the requested radius while keeping useful joint-limit margin.
missions.transferText: The target is near maximum extension. Reach it without collapsing into a straight-arm singular posture.

missions.title: SINGULARITIES & COLLISION
missions.concept: A pose can be mathematically reachable yet be a poor operating point because motion authority collapses near a singularity or links collide.
missions.scenario: Route the wrist through a service opening without straightening the arm or clipping the torso.
missions.goalText: Find a configuration with usable motion authority, positive collision clearance and enough reach.
missions.transferText: Adapt the posture after the tool increases the swept volume.

missions.title: KINEMATICS GATE
missions.concept: Demonstrate frames, joint axes, FK/IK, reachability, joint limits and collision-aware configuration selection in one integrated exercise.
missions.scenario: Commission the arm for three target poses around a service rack.

gateCases.name: FRAME TARGET
gateCases.text: Reach WORLD x≈0.60 m, z≈0.30 m.

gateCases.name: LIMITED IK
gateCases.text: Reach x≈0.45 m, z≈0.48 m while q2 stays negative.

gateCases.name: COLLISION-AWARE
gateCases.text: Keep positive rack clearance and manipulability > 0.30.
